Popular chef Rachel Khoo now lives in the Swedish countryside in a charming, traditional wooden house that serves as her base for the series. In every episode, she meets up with local food producers or a Swedish chef and visits stores and restaurants that focus on Swedish craftsmanship. Then it's back home to the kitchen, where she puts her twist on local recipes, preparing delicious, healthy food that's easy for anyone to cook at home.

What does it take for everyday hawker stalls to earn Michelin recognition, and can they keep their Bib Gourmand status? How has the accolade impacted the life of these humble hawkers? At Bahrakath Mutton Soup, sole chef Syed Abdul Rahaman grapples with passing down this award-winning taste to his sons as age creeps up on him. Over at Selamat Datang Warong Pak Sapari, second-generation owner Sumadi Sapari walks the tightrope between expanding the business and protecting the authenticity of his late father's recipe. For Koh Brother Pig Organ Soup, Thomas Koh left his career to carry on a family legacy. After failed franchising attempts, he's poured himself into making every bowl the best it can be. And at Chef Kang's Noodle House, brothers Benson and Winson Moo—disciples of Michelin-starred Chef Kang—have won, lost, and regained their Bib Gourmand. This year, the question looms: can they hold onto it?

Each episode you'll get all the secrets straight from your favorite action heroes, get exclusive trivia and special reports from the most dangerous film sets, and get insight information on how the filmmakers make giant monsters come to life. This show is a sci-fi, cowboy, world-destruction, action-combo that will literally blow your mind!

This drama is set in the Jiufen area from the 1960s to the 1970s. It tells the story of how three brothers conquered the world with their bare hands. Through the love story of the previous generation, it connects the common emotions between the two generations depicting the memories and in-depth exploration of the differences in values between them. 本剧以1960年代至1970年代的九份地区为背景，述说三个拜把兄弟如何赤手空拳打天下，藉由上一代的爱情故事串连与第二代之间共同的情感与记忆，深度探索两代之间的价值观差异。

Man Wai-sum retired from the media six months ago. With a background in marketing management, Kingston Koo is abruptly appointed as director. Deputy Director Cheung Ka-yin takes over Leung King-yan’s status but struggles to gain the respect of her colleagues. Wai-sum makes a strong comeback as the Queen of News, acquiring the online media platform founded by Lau Yim and challenges conventional mainstream media. 文慧心（佘诗曼饰）退隐新闻界半年，SNK生巨变。市场管理出身的古肇华（黄宗泽饰）空降总监一职，视新闻为赚钱工具；副总监张家妍（李施嬅饰）取代了梁景仁（马国明饰）的地位，纵握大权却难服众。慧心以“新闻女王”姿态强势回归，收购刘艳（王敏奕饰）创办的网媒公开平台，向传统主流媒体发起挑战。KOL唐芷瑶（陈晓华饰）利用自媒体，对慧心展开恶意狙击。

Every Body Knows is a talkshow that advocates healthy lifestyle! Doctors, TCM physicians and nutritionist will share their knowledge and addressing on common myth or health issues. Mark Lee, Lee Teng & Kym Ng will take turn to host. Hence, be sure to catch this show! 《医聊大小事》是一档倡导健康生活、关注全民健康的保健节目。医生、中医师、营养师将呈现与示范最实用的健康贴士、筛查、食疗等。主持人李国煌、李腾和鐘琴的妙语如珠，将让资讯变得浅而易懂。千万别错过这一档可以一起长知识的节目！

Li Zhongcheng was a HDB officer in the 90s. Thirty years later, his son Yiwei follows his path and reconnects with childhood friends Fang Ying and Daping. Ying, a renovator, resents her absent father, while Daping is a scammer. Yiwei reunites with his long-lost brother Jiewei, only to face his revenge—and learns he caused Ying’s misfortunes. 90年代组屋保姆李忠诚热心助人，其子奕伟和杰伟，与方颖、达平及Kumar皆童年玩伴情深。30年后奕伟继承父志当组屋保姆，意外重逢装修商方颖，却发现童年好友达平沦为骗子且性格扭曲。方颖怨父弃家与母相依为命；奕伟终寻回被拐弟弟杰伟，却遭弟弟怀恨蓄意报复。更震惊发现，方颖的坎坷人生竟是自己造成……

A petty official in the Tang Dynasty is given the impossible task of delivering fresh lychee from Lingnan to Imperial Consort Yang's birthday banquet in Chang'an, a distance of over 2500 kilometers. He has three months to make the impossible possible. The penalty for failure is death for him and slavery for his family.

Xiao Wu Xia, the young lord of Yueluo City, has been living in hiding in Liang Kingdom under the alias Wei Zhao, bearing the shame of being labeled a traitor. His mission is to uncover the truth behind his family’s downfall and capture the sole survivor of Prince Qi’s case. However, his plans are derailed by the unexpected arrival of Jiang Ci. Pei Yan takes the injured Jiang Ci into his home, aiming to discover who’s behind the disruption.

Xu Wei Hao was born with a silver spoon. After the decline of his family wealth, he remains unambitious, even his daughter looks down on him. Wei Hao's neighbor, Li Zheng Yi, is a cowardly cop. He is in a relationship with Liu Xue Hua, a single mother and they live together. Her children refuse to accept him as their stepfather. Xue Hua refuse to forgive her ex-husband, Chen Kai, who has just been released from prison. The three men accidentally ate mysterious chocolates ... 许伟豪出身富裕的伟豪，在家道中落后依旧缺乏进取心，连女儿也看不起他。住在伟豪同层楼的邻居李正义是个胆小怕事的警察，他与单亲妈妈刘雪华交往并同住在一屋檐下，可是雪华的儿女却拒绝接受这个小男人当后父。雪华无法原谅刚出狱的前夫陈凯，还告诉他孩子们也不会认这个作奸犯科的爸爸。三个男人人无意中吃了神秘巧克力…

Modern women with new-age beliefs. Is marriage really hell or bliss? Papa Hao is a widowed restaurant chef who single-handedly raised three daughters. Eldest daughter Meiman is a successful advertising agent who believes that women should always place career before marriage. Ironic to her extravagant lifestyle, Meiman ends up with her miserly colleague whom she bickers with incessantly from workplace to home.. Second daughter Meili is a TV producer who yearns to start a family but is always rejected by her matchmaking prospects because of her ordinary looks. When she finally chances upon her Korean Prince Charming, she finds that her younger sister too has fallen for the same guy...Youngest daughter Meide is an independent and open-minded graduate who has been spoilt by her father and sisters. While she enjoys the pursuit by her suitors, she does not equate love to marriage. Not until she meets her traditional mother-in-law-to-be and sparks start flying... Like all romantic fairy tales, will the three sisters get married and live happily ever after?

Phraphai, a skilled heart surgeon, is married to electrical engineer Din. They have a three-year-old daughter, Namnile, but Phraphai’s demanding career and motherhood leave little room for romance. Din turns to Frame during a drunken moment. While Din sees it as a mistake, Frame sees an opportunity and schemes to break up the couple. Phraphai uncovers the affair and confronts Din. The situation sparks a full-blown love war between the women. Phraphai 是一位熟练的心脏外科医生，她嫁给了电气工程师Din。两人有一个三岁的女儿。自从成为医生和母亲后，繁忙的工作及家庭生活，使Phraphai对爱情提不起兴致。在喝醉的状态下，Din滑倒并与Frame睡在一起。然而，对于Frame来说，这并不是一个错误。她想要更多，她想办法让Din与妻子断绝关系，但Phraphai很聪明。她找出了证据并向Din下了最后通牒，结果一场全面的爱情战争就此拉开序幕。

The Middle East crisis and the resulting blockade of the Strait of Hormuz has caused supply disruptions for the globe, which can potentially lead to catastrophic consequences for modern civilization. The global economy, agriculture, energy production, and transportation infrastructure rely heavily on oil products such as petrol, diesel and liquified natural gas. So, is life without oil possible? A 4-part human interest series tries to answer this question as the filmmakers traverse Pakistan, Bangladesh, India, and Philippines to meet communities, governments and entrepreneurs building the future of human civilization with renewable energies like solar, biogas, organic fertilizers, and electric vehicles. We understand if this quiet transformation across Asia is sustainable and if life without oil can one day become a reality.

Noreen is an independent and successful woman whose seemingly perfect life is overshadowed by loneliness. She falls for her charismatic colleague, Farhan, only to discover he is married. His wife, Sheila, lives in the village caring for her mother, who has dementia. As Noreen and Farhan grow closer, Sheila begins to sense the growing distance in her marriage, forcing painful truths to surface.
Haikal begins to regain his memory, including the crimes he committed. Suriya is questioned by police over Aurora’s kidnapping.
Don't miss the continuing adventures as Beyblade pros from around the world gather to compete in the Pro League held inside the X Tower!

A tight knit quirky family of three makes a great recipe for an excellent meal and a good laugh. Lesung is a cooking show that blends traditional and modern food demonstration with a light hearted family drama. Lesung adalah drama info yang memaparkan pertunjukan masakan makanan tradisional dan moden. Ia menceritakan tentang kisah sebuah kelauarga dan bagaimana masakan dan makanan boleh eratkan lagi hubungan mereka.

In order to win Rosemaria's heart and heirloom, Dylea hunts for the lost grandchild and finds him in the hands of Zaheem. Can Dylea convinces Zaheem to hand over the child with her evil aunty Anita breathing down her neck?
Catch the latest local and international news on Suria.

Ada Apa Dengan Cikgu O? (What's up with Mr O?) follows a mysterious Malay Language teacher with an extraordinary way of teaching life lessons. Inspired by works from local authors, each episode takes a student on a magical adventure where their choices, attitudes and values are put to the test. Funny, thrilling and full of surprises, every journey proves that the most meaningful lessons are not simply taught, but experienced. Ada Apa Dengan Cikgu O mengisahkan seorang guru Bahasa Melayu yang penuh misteri dan mempunyai cara luar biasa untuk mendidik murid-muridnya. Diinspirasikan daripada karya-karya penulis tempatan, setiap episod membawa seorang murid mengembara ke dunia ajaib yang menguji sikap, pilihan dan nilai kehidupannya. Setiap pengembaraan membuktikan bahawa pengajaran paling bermakna tidak sekadar dipelajari, malah perlu dialami.

After accidentally stepping on Aslan’s foot, Nuna attempts to make amends, but her approach to seeking forgiveness fails to appease Aslan, leaving their already strained interaction even more awkward.

p.t: Tiada Seperti Leyla (My Enemy, My Crush)
p.d: After being kicked out of her internship for beating up a sleazy supervisor, Leyla must start over at a new company under the supervision of her former high school nemesis, Daniel. As old grudges resurface, an unexpected spark begins to stir, turning enemies into something more.

Follow our host, Zaki Hussain, as he embarks on a journey to explore various Malay art forms while uncovering its rich history. He meets with local artists who specialises in that art form while ensuring its continuity. Watch them challenge our host to attempt the art first hand while unearthing it's impact on our Singapore creative scene, both in the past and the present. Ikuti hos kami, Zaki Hussain, meneroka pelbagai seni Melayu sambil mempelajari sejarahnya. Dia bertemu dengan seniman tempatan yang pakar dalam seni tersebut sambil gigih melestarikannya. Saksikan bagaimana mereka mencabar Zaki mencuba seni tertentu sambil mencungkil pengaruh seni tersebut pada persada kreatif Singapura.
